about: The Haftarah from the Prophets reminds us of Noah. Just as God promised never to flood the earth again, he promises that his love for Israel will never go away. The reading from the Apostles shows God making everything new, with no more tears and no more sadness.
prompts: How does the Haftarah connect to this week's Torah Portion?
How do the Apostles connect to this week's Torah Portion?
